subject: Cross-border risk mitigation playbook — technical evidence and DPF clarifications
messages:
From: Lucy Holt <lucy.holt@solsticetherapeutics.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPF control mapping + runtime evidence for RFP (Solstice)

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this RFP — we’re compiling a technical appendix for our privacy & legal teams and need a clear mapping from Redwood runtime features to the DPF controls we listed (routing/residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs, KV/prefix caching behavior, fallback policies for model variants).

Specifically can you:
- Provide a single-sheet mapping (control -> Redwood feature -> evidence artifact) we can attach to our DPA annex?
- Confirm where (region/HSM) keys are stored and support for customer-managed KMS in EU regions.
- Clarify whether token-level audit logs include prompt/response hashes only or full payloads, and retention windows.
- Note any operational exclusions (e.g., on-prem-only controls).

We’re on an aggressive procurement timeline and would appreciate initial materials by EOD Monday (2028-06-11). Happy to set a quick follow-up call if needed.

Thanks,
Lucy Holt
Head of Procurement
Solstice Therapeutics
[soliciting specific DPF/annex mapping for legal review]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Holt <lucy.holt@solsticetherapeutics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPF control mapping + runtime evidence for RFP (Solstice)

Lucy —

Appreciate the clear ask. We put together an initial mapping and attached the workbook and the DPA annex tracker. Highlights below; full mappings are in redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx (sheet: "DPF-Mapping").

Quick summary:
- Routing / residency: region pinning is supported for both Hosted and Dedicated modes. We can enforce EU-only processing with VPC/private deployment and an allowlist of subnets. Evidence: routing logs + region-asserted traces (Attachment: dpa-annex-tracking.pdf).
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed KMS is supported via integrations in GCP/AWS Azure Key Vault. For Private (on-prem) we provide HSM connectors; Hosted supports CMEK in supported cloud regions.
- Audit logs: token-level telemetry stored in our observability plane includes request metadata, token counts, and a SHA-256 of payloads by default. Full plaintext payloads are available only under Customer-managed Private deployments (per contract). Retention: default 90 days; custom retention available via enterprise contract.
- KV/prefix caching: automatic prefix caching is runtime-configurable and can be disabled per-customer. Evidence: KV cache audit and cache-ttl settings in the mapping workbook.
- Fallback policies: we publish rollout and fallback policies (canary -> A/B -> fallback to lower-cost variant). Evidence: rollout logs and policy config example in workbook.

Attachments: redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx (mapping + evidence pointers), dpa-annex-tracking.pdf (tracker with clause references).

We’re looping in Kimberly and Karthik to add technical implementation notes and an ops-ready statement suitable for procurement/legal. If you want a short call tomorrow for any clarifications we can do 30 mins; I’m available 10:00–11:30 PT.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-dpf-mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: dpa-annex-tracking.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Lucy Holt <lucy.holt@solsticetherapeutics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPF control mapping + runtime evidence for RFP (Solstice)

Hi Lucy / team — following up with more concrete, technical clarifications pulled from runtime and ops: 

1) KMS/HSM & key locality
- Hosted: supports CMEK via cloud provider KMS (customer-managed). Keys can be bound by region (e.g., EU-West1). Our control plane never holds plaintext keys; envelope encryption used at rest.
- Dedicated/Private: supports HSM-based key stores (PKCS#11) and direct customer HSM integrations. We provide an audit of HSM attestation on request.

2) Audit logs and payloads
- Default (Hosted): audit logs = request metadata, token counts, model id, and a SHA-256 hash of prompt/response. This is sufficient for integrity checks and correlation without retaining PII.
- Private (customer-managed): option to enable full payload logging (encrypted at rest under customer KMS). We note this in the DPA annex as a configurable item.
- Retention windows: default 90 days; we can extend to 1+ years for enterprise contracts, or support on-prem retention policies when Private is deployed.

3) Routing / residency and data flows
- Smart routing supports origin-based routing and hard pins. We can produce per-request routing headers and region-asserted traces for audit.
- For Solstice’s EU processing requirement: recommend Dedicated pool in eu-west1 + VPC NAT to keep egress inside the region. Operational exception: ephemeral cache shards may be located in same-region replicas; no cross-region shard writes unless explicitly enabled.

4) KV/prefix caching and privacy implications
- Cache default behavior: prefix KV caches are stored encrypted and segregated per-tenant. Cache eviction policies and TTLs are exposed in the mapping workbook. We can disable caching for specific routes.

5) DPF mapping notes (action items for procurement/legal)
- We flagged three DPF controls that require contractual acknowledgment (customer-managed KMS settings, audit retention beyond default, and on-prem payload logging).
- Proposed language snippets are on the Drive link in the workbook — these are vendor-neutral and have been accepted previously by other EU-based pharma customers.

Next steps:
- Avery / Ben: can you confirm the exact retention term Solstice prefers so we can prepare a redline?
- Lucy: If you want HSM attestation, please indicate preferred format (FIPS/CAVP) and we’ll schedule a short ops handoff call.

Quoted message included below for context.

Kimberly / Avery —

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail our privacy and procurement teams wanted. A couple final clarifying questions before we close this out:

- For hosted deployments, can you confirm whether full plaintext payloads are ever stored outside of EU region snapshots (e.g., for troubleshooting)?
- Can Redwood provide a short attestation template for HSM integration (we prefer FIPS-140-2 level 3 attestation language)?
- For the audit retention, we’re evaluating a 12-month retention for request metadata and hashes; please confirm if there are additional costs and lead times.

If you can reply with concise confirmations (or attach a 1–2 paragraph attestation) we can move the DPA redline to legal review today.

Best,
Lucy Holt
Head of Procurement — Solstice Therapeutics
